flows.title: Declare an incident
steps: In the top navigation bar, click + New Incident.
In the Create New Incident dialog, enter a Title. The Incident Type is pre-filled; select another if needed.
Optionally select the Impacted Service and enter a description, an urgency and a priority.
Assign the incident by selecting an escalation policy or a user from their tabs.
Click Create Incident. PagerDuty notifies the escalation policy or user you selected.

flows.title: Acknowledge or resolve an incident
steps: Navigate to Incidents to view the Open Incidents page.
Select the checkbox to the left of the incident.
Click Acknowledge, or Resolve, in the actions menu bar. On an incident's details page, reached by clicking its title, the same buttons are in the actions menu bar.

flows.title: Add a user
steps: In the PagerDuty web app, navigate to People > Users.
Click Add Users in the top right corner of the page.
Enter the user's Name (first and last) and Email Address, select the License type if applicable, and select their Base Role. If the account has Teams, optionally select a Team.
Click Add. PagerDuty emails the user an invitation to accept.
